# apple_app_clips (Data Source)

Lists an app's App Clips. An App Clip appears once a build that contains it is uploaded.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_app_clips" "app" {
  app_id = data.apple_app.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Read-Only

- `app_clips` (Attributes List) The App Clips. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--app_clips))

<a id="nestedatt--app_clips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `app_clips`

Read-Only:

- `bundle_id` (String) Bundle identifier of the App Clip, e.g. `com.example.app.Clip`.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Clip.
